title: Offscreen | PostgreSQL (CNPG)
description: Repository-owned and read-only. Edit in Git, not in the UI.

options.content:
Freshness rule: a current target is `up == 1` with sample age at most 90s. Missing or stale samples are unknown, never healthy and never zero. `up` is scrape availability only, not backend health.

**Partial scope (owner ratified).** Panels cover only admitted client groups (selected application names, roles and databases) of Cluster dev-pg. Connection counts and occupancy are lower bounds, not global saturation or distinct sessions. Replication panels apply only to an instance in recovery. No custom SQL, backup, WAL archive or per-query metrics are enrolled.

panels.description: Current scrape state only, not backend health; missing/stale unknown, never synthetic zero.

targets.expr: up{job="postgres-cnpg"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="postgres-cnpg"}) <= 90)
